style: Palette of toxic lime green, hot pink, chalky cream and asphalt black, with purple and teal alien accents. No text, letters, words or logos anywhere, the graffiti is pure shapes and colors.

images.prompt: Wide side view of a cratered, crumbling hilly landscape cut by explosions, like a cross-section of earth with tunnels and loose rocks. On a hill on the right stand three boxy, clearly mechanical scrap mecha robots painted in lime and pink spray-paint patterns, with spiked armor plates and rocket launchers welded together. Across the valley on the far left horizon, a grim angular purple alien fortress with turrets. The lower left of the picture is calm open ground.

Side view of a destructible dirt and rock landscape: a boxy, clearly mechanical scrap mecha robot painted in lime and pink spray-paint patterns, with spiked armor plates, leaps through the air over a smoking crater, firing a cluster of four rocket launchers welded together toward a squat purple alien bunker on a hill. Clumps of dirt and rocks fly from the crater rim. A dotted arc trail behind the jumping robot.

Side view of a bulky, clearly mechanical purple alien war robot with heavy angular armor, knocked off its feet and sent flying backwards off a cliff edge by a bright burst of impact, tumbling through the air above a deep gorge, bolts and armor plates and rocks spinning around it. Bold speed lines, big empty sky.

Tall portrait illustration: inside a cluttered scrap workshop in a garage, two boxy, clearly mechanical scrap mecha robots painted in lime and pink spray-paint patterns, with spiked armor plates and rocket launchers welded together, stand parked side by side under a single hanging work lamp, tools, tires and spray cans around their feet. The garage door is open behind them onto a dusky sky with a huge angular purple alien battleship. The top third of the picture is that sky. Pure illustration with no lettering.

Wide view of a ruined city skyline at dusk under alien occupation: huge angular purple alien battleships float in the sky above broken towers, and a grim alien fortress with spikes is built over the ruins. In the foreground, a small cluttered scrap workshop in a garage, its walls covered in lime and pink spray-paint patterns, warm light spilling out of its open door.
